MANDARIN MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MANDARIN MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Descriptive Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Descriptive Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Descriptive Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Descriptive Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Descriptive Writing.
